description: Use when someone asks whether the EU AI Act applies to an AI system or model, how it is classified or what they must do ('is our recruitment tool high-risk?', 'does the AI Act apply to our chatbot?', 'what are our AI Act obligations as a deployer?'). Call without answers to get the questions. Call with answers about one system to get whether it is in scope, the role (provider, deployer, importer, distributor; Art. 25 role change), the classification (prohibited, high-risk under Annex I or III, Art. 6(3) exception, Art. 50 transparency, minimal risk, GPAI model), and each obligation with its article and the date it applies from, using the dates of the AI Act as amended by the 2026 Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744). A self-assessment from the user's answers, not legal advice.

answers.description: Answers about one AI system; call without answers for the question texts. Lists: prohibited (p1-p9), annex_iii (h1-h8), transparency (t1-t5). Omitted lists count as none, omitted yes/no answers as no.
